# Project working conventions

- Keep the portfolio brand focused on JMW Studios and premium black-and-gold presentation.
- Preserve the public portfolio and SaaS architecture while completing real product features.
- Prefer clear domain separation: public web, dashboard, admin, API, database, and shared packages.
- Validate changes with tests and a production build before concluding work.
- Keep documentation aligned with the actual product direction and current implementation.

## Delivery checklist

- [ ] Confirm the user-facing brand direction and page goals.
- [ ] Implement the required public-facing experience and feature pages.
- [ ] Keep the dashboard/admin routes aligned with the product architecture.
- [ ] Validate the app with the relevant test and build commands.
- [ ] Keep README and project docs current and accurate.
